items.rationale: The existing fixed kitchen unit qualifies as a building component under §4.2.2, with no kitchen-specific exclusion. If the surge is confirmed to be atmospheric under §2.3.3 and the fire group is in force, §§7.1.9–7.1.10 allow one equivalent replacement at €1,413 gross.
Necessary installation of a covered replacement follows the unit under §7.1.11, at €480 gross for one installation. Any labour for unrelated or uninsured equipment must be separated under §9.5.

The claim establishes that a floor-standing console was already in use, but not that it was damaged or could not be reused. Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.7, one equivalent console is estimated at €61 gross if its replacement is shown to be necessary for the covered repair.
Under §7.1.11, freight is covered to the extent it relates to covered replacement equipment: one shipment at €43 gross. Freight for any non-covered items must be apportioned out.
